To determine how long it will take Bob to dig the hole, we need to calculate the total volume of earth to be removed and then apply the given rate of shoveling.

**Step 1: Calculate the volume of the hole.**
The hole is a rectangular prism with the following dimensions:
*   Length = 6 feet
*   Width = 4 feet
*   Depth = 3 feet

The volume $V$ is calculated as:
$$V = \text{Length} \times \text{Width} \times \text{Depth}$$
$$V = 6 \times 4 \times 3$$
$$V = 24 \times 3$$
$$V = 72 \text{ cubic feet}$$

**Step 2: Calculate the total time required.**
Bob takes 3 seconds to shovel 1 cubic foot of earth. To find the total time, we multiply the total volume by the time per cubic foot:
$$\text{Total Time} = \text{Volume} \times \text{Time per cubic foot}$$
$$\text{Total Time} = 72 \times 3$$
$$\text{Total Time} = 216 \text{ seconds}$$

Final answer: 216
